section.div: Open source tool to safely clean orphaned Windows Installer files and reclaim disk space
A desktop music library builder that turns Spotify, Apple Music, Amazon Music, Tidal, Qobuz, and Deezer links into fully tagged local downloads in FLAC, ALAC, AAC, or MP3.
🎧 Open source music streaming app! Available for both desktop & mobile!
🎒 Token-Oriented Object Notation (TOON) – Compact, human-readable, schema-aware JSON for LLM prompts. Spec, benchmarks, TypeScript SDK.
